Package planning

Class AbstractAction

java.lang.Object
planning.AbstractAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicAction
public abstract class AbstractAction extends Object implements Action
The AbstractAction class provides a base implementation for actions in a planning domain, including preconditions and effects. It partially implements the Action interface, managing the core data and providing methods for retrieving and setting preconditions and effects.

  • Constructor Details

    • AbstractAction

      public AbstractAction(Map<Variable,Object> preconditions, Map<Variable,Object> effects)
      Constructs an AbstractAction with specified preconditions and effects.
      Parameters:
      preconditions - a map of variables to their required values that define the conditions under which the action is applicable.
      effects - a map of variables to their new values that represent the outcome of the action when applied.
